facts.business: The Andhra Sugars Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar, chlor-alkali products, and other chemicals.
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include subsidiary companies JOCIL Limited, The Andhra Farm Chemical Corporation Limited, Hindustan Allied Chemical Limited, key management personnel (whole-time directors and independent directors), and relatives of key management personnel. Transactions include a loan of Rs. 150.00 lakhs to Sree Akkamamba Textiles Limited.
